body: Keep bias and dark lift; raise gain so grading-stage white is 253/255. Optical power and reflected contribution remain unchanged.
scope: One user-requested five-option comparison, no optimizer or adoption. Geometry finalized; no new lens rays, source sampling, blur, shadow field, artwork adjustment or dispersion.
